mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name FROM users WHERE (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) AND id != #{excludeUserId} ORDER BY display_name LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_connection WHERE (requester_id = #{userA} AND addressee_id = #{userB}) OR (requester_id = #{userB} AND addressee_id = #{userA})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_connection (requester_id, addressee_id, status) VALUES (#{row.requesterId}, #{row.addresseeId}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, requester_id, addressee_id, status, requester_shares_from, requester_shares_until, addressee_shares_from, addressee_shares_until FROM friend_connection WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_connection SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT fc.id, u.id AS other_user_id, u.username AS other_username, u.display_name AS other_display_name, fc.status, NULL AS my_shares_from, NULL AS my_shares_until, NULL AS friend_shares_from, NULL AS friend_shares_until, FALSE AS comparison_available, fc.created_at FROM friend_connection fc JOIN users u ON u.id = fc.requester_id WHERE fc.addressee_id = #{userId} AND fc.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY fc.created_at DESC

SELECT fc.id, u.id AS other_user_id, u.username AS other_username, u.display_name AS other_display_name, fc.status, NULL AS my_shares_from, NULL AS my_shares_until, NULL AS friend_shares_from, NULL AS friend_shares_until, FALSE AS comparison_available, fc.created_at FROM friend_connection fc JOIN users u ON u.id = fc.addressee_id WHERE fc.requester_id = #{userId} AND fc.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY fc.created_at DESC

SELECT fc.id, CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN u2.id ELSE u1.id END AS other_user_id, CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN u2.username ELSE u1.username END AS other_username, CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN u2.display_name ELSE u1.display_name END AS other_display_name, fc.status, CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN fc.requester_shares_from ELSE fc.addressee_shares_from END AS my_shares_from, CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN fc.requester_shares_until ELSE fc.addressee_shares_until END AS my_shares_until, CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN fc.addressee_shares_from ELSE fc.requester_shares_from END AS friend_shares_from, CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN fc.addressee_shares_until ELSE fc.requester_shares_until END AS friend_shares_until, (fc.requester_shares_from IS NOT NULL AND fc.requester_shares_until IS NOT NULL AND fc.addressee_shares_from IS NOT NULL AND fc.addressee_shares_until IS NOT NULL) AS comparison_available, fc.created_at FROM friend_connection fc JOIN users u1 ON u1.id = fc.requester_id JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = fc.addressee_id WHERE (fc.requester_id = #{userId} OR fc.addressee_id = #{userId}) AND fc.status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY fc.created_at DESC
